title: [AAPS 3.0-beta1] AAPS Showing 60% Profile, Pump Running 100%. Cancel Temp Profile Fails
symptom: AAPS shows a 60% temp basal while the pump is actually running 100% basal. Attempts to cancel the temp basal fail with a 'Temp basal delivery' error. The discrepancy persists until CGM data resumes.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but the issue was fixed by a commit, implying a bug in AAPS related to temp basal handling.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/d520c45aba655ef5c9212e66c9d3f9e7b7eb10e9
